A group of college nerds secretly record a washed up celebrity having sex and post the tape on the internet. When the publicity revives the actress's career, every B-list celebrity in Hollywood wants to star in the guys next "production."

In this insightful and witty satire, Woody Allen portrays an uninspired comedic filmmaker who retreats to a room at the Stardust Hotel to reflect on his life, art and relationships with three contrastingly different women.
The twisted minds of the writers of Scary Movie skewer the romantic comedy genre in DATE MOVIE, a film for people who love date movies and people who hate them.

Once told they'd save the universe during a time-traveling adventure, two would-be rockers from San Dimas, California find themselves as middle-aged dads still trying to crank out a hit song and fulfill their destiny.
